content: उत्सर्पिन् {%a.%} .²1 Moving or gliding upwards, rising; पयोधरोत्सर्पिषु (शीकरेषु) <ls>R. 16. 62</ls>. .²2 Soaring, towering; उत्सर्पिणी खलु महतां प्रार्थना <ls>Ś. 7</ls>. .²3 Causing to increase or rise. .²4 Transcendental. .{@-णी@} {%f.%} A division of time (with the Jainas), a long period said to be = ten crores of crores of oceans of years; <ab>cf.</ab> अवसर्पिणी.
